agentDetailResidual.leftAgentNotice: You left this agent. It no longer appears in your sidebar.
agentDetailResidual.invalidChainDescription: {{agent}} cannot accept tasks or start runs until its reporting chain is repaired.
agentDetailResidual.invalidChainRepair: Assign this agent to an active manager/root, or explicitly pause or terminate the affected agent/subtree.
agentDetailResidual.workActionsDisabled: Repair this agent's reporting chain before assigning tasks or starting runs
agentDetailResidual.pauseBuiltInDescription: {{feature}} depends on this agent. While paused, {{featureLower}} generation is skipped and the {{feature}} page shows a warning.
agentDetailResidual.builtInDescription: Ships with Paperclip and powers {{feature}}. Configure it like any agent — model, instructions, budget. It can be paused but not deleted; pausing it pauses {{feature}}.
agentDetailResidual.instructionsLocalOnly: Instructions bundles are only available for local adapters.
agentDetailResidual.savedInstructions: Saved instructions affect the next run. Active runs keep the instructions they started with, and instruction changes may start a fresh adapter session.
agentDetailResidual.modeHelp: Managed: Paperclip stores and serves the instructions bundle. External: you provide a path on disk where the instructions live.
agentDetailResidual.rootPathHelp: The absolute directory on disk where the instructions bundle lives. In managed mode this is set by Paperclip automatically.
agentDetailResidual.entryFileHelp: The main file the agent reads first when loading instructions. Defaults to AGENTS.md.
agentDetailResidual.legacyVirtualFile: Legacy inline prompt — this deprecated virtual file preserves the old promptTemplate content
agentDetailResidual.noPersistedTranscript: No persisted transcript for this run.
